settings.heading: Art for slow, considered spaces.
settings.text: Original contemporary paintings and archival fine art prints by the artist Shalini. Here is how each work is made, sized, documented and sent to you.

settings.title: Original paintings
settings.text: Singular works built slowly by hand. Every original arrives signed with a studio certificate of authenticity.

settings.title: Canvas prints
settings.text: Matte canvas prints stretched over pinewood frames, signed and numbered by the artist.

settings.title: Ask the studio
settings.text: Ask for close-ups, scale images, or a short studio video of any available work.

settings.heading: Original or print?
settings.text: Both begin in the same studio. Choose the singular painting, or a signed edition made to last.

settings.heading: One of one
settings.points:
A unique painting, built slowly by hand
Signed by the artist
Certificate of authenticity included
Ships carefully wrapped and insured, complimentary across India

settings.heading: Signed editions
settings.points:
Matte canvas stretched over a 0.75 in pinewood frame
Signed and numbered by the artist
Four Printify sizes, from 8 × 10 to 30 × 40 inches
Corner-protected, securely boxed, and ready to hang

settings.heading: Print sizes, to scale.
settings.text: Canvas prints come in four sizes. Choose one to see it drawn to true scale on a wall. Each print page lists the sizes that work is offered in.

settings.fallback_alt: Pigments, brushes and linen on the studio table
settings.heading: Carefully packed, from our studio to your wall.
settings.text:
Originals ship carefully wrapped and insured, with tracking, and shipping is complimentary across India.

Canvas prints are corner-protected, securely boxed, and dispatched ready to hang.

settings.heading: Meet Shalini.
settings.text: A contemporary painter working from an intuitive language of colour, gesture, and natural form.
